title.zh: 将苏禄省 Panamao市镇 Seit 中央小学的名称变更为Panglima Agga 中央小学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Seit Central Elementary School in the Municipality of Panamao, Province of Sulu, to Panglima Agga Central Elementary School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Seit Central Elementary School in the Municipality of Panamao, Province of Sulu, to Panglima Agga Central Elementary School

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1964/ra_3918_1964.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Seit Central Elementary School in the Municipality of Panamao, Province of Sulu, is changed to Panglima Agga Central Elementary School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 18, 1964.
